predictions: We have our first unreported match of the season, so we're short one result from last week. So far, I've posted a just-pretty-decent 16-8 record for the week, with five more of my eight wrong picks being flipped or tied on a single dart (as per usual). The more consistent part from last week is how many teams played without their best players, or played shorthanded altogether. Those are just so tough to overcome. Anyway, that brings me to 184-88 (67.7% correct) so far this season.

Match of the week: (F Div.) Duck Duck Groove @ Bottoms Up. The Ducks are two matches behind the Bottoms, but they are only three points behind them, and they would hold the dead-heat tiebreaker if they can win by anything more than a 1001. So, the F race is anything but over. Unless the Bottoms win this one, that is… in which case the race attention in F would switch to a race for 2nd instead. I'm guessing the Bottoms bring all their big four (and list them!). BU, 14-10.

Match #2: (C Div.) The Outlaws @ Mulligan's Mafia. The Outlaws just lost a match, and their opponent next week already took them to 1001 six weeks ago. Translation? If the Mafia (and their slight point lead) can win this one, another win the next week might just be enough to rise to the C crown. And the Mafia already beat The Outlaws once, so who says they won't again? Well… I do, I guess… Outlaws, 13-11.

Match #3: (A Div.) Dart Attack @ Talladega Flights. Fringe and Dart Attack each losing two of their last three has really sort of created (or maybe re-started?) the mess of teams from 2nd through 5th in A. Time is short now for Dart Attack, but Talladega is certainly still within very doable reach of 2nd. Attack is good, but I'll ride with Talladega, 13-11.

Match #4: (E Div.) Cheap Shots @ Runs with Corks. Bangin and Rippin both still have to face Dirty Darts one more time. So this battle of 4th/5th place teams (who both presently sit with losing records!) might actually decide a team that could eventually slide all the way up to 2nd place. Corks won huge last time. But not this time… CS, 13-11.

Matches #5 & #6: (C Div.) One Armed Bandits @ Darty Sanchez; Nine Lives @ Village Idiots. C division is a wild mess of equality and randomness (it HAS to be - that's the only possible defense for my pick record there). And if The Outlaws handle their business in match #2 above, then a win by Sanchez tonight would bring every team from 2nd-6th within one loss of each other. This parity is getting out of hand, and you just have to love it. Sadly, I'm thinking the outcomes that make this NOT as tight of a group will prevail. The Bandits and Idiots win, each by 13-11 scores. (Luckily for Sanchez and the Niners, I'm usually wrong here in C. So congrats to them.)

Matches #7 & #8: (B Div.) Darty Minds @ Kilts In The Hall; Consistently Inconsistent @ Raging Bulls Eyes. With Kilts In The Hall taking down Inconsistent last week, the real race in B this fall is now those two teams fighting for 2nd (and very possibly a spot in the league's top division next season). And they both still face undefeated Darty Minds. The race is on… In The Hall takes their turn falling to Darty, 16-8; while Inconsistent moves ahead, 14-10.
Match #9: (A Div.) Double In Stumble Out @ Why So Serious? One winless team left now that Sam's Brother's won in B last week. Is this their last shot to leave the club? Yep. But it's Serious, 14-10.
Match #10: (E Div.) Sharky's Machine @ Death Throw. Unless the loser of match #4 above goes on a losing streak, the hard reality is the loser here likely might be headed down to F. Machine, 13-11.
Match #11: (F Div.) Armed & Hammered @ Shark Shooters. If Nein Mark gets hot, is this loser in jeopardy of falling to a bottom- two spot and a possible spot in G next season?! Armed in 1001?
And the remaining 14 matches, sorted by division:
